Class RentalFileService

java.lang.Object
software.project.RentalFileService
public class RentalFileService extends Object
Provides services for managing rental records stored in a text file. This class allows checking vehicle availability, displaying customer rental history, and saving new rental information.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Jannat Zaidan, Hala Sleibe, Wijdan Risheh

  • Method Details

    • isVehicleRented

      public boolean isVehicleRented(int vehicleId)
      Checks whether a vehicle is currently rented. A vehicle is considered rented if its rental end date is today or in the future.
      Parameters:
      vehicleId - The ID of the vehicle to check.
      Returns:
      true if the vehicle is currently rented, otherwise false.

    • isVehicleAvailable

      public boolean isVehicleAvailable(int vehicleId, LocalDate requestedStart, LocalDate requestedEnd)
      Checks whether a vehicle is available for the requested rental period. The vehicle is considered unavailable if its existing rental period overlaps with the requested start and end dates.
      Parameters:
      vehicleId - The ID of the vehicle to check.
      requestedStart - The requested rental start date.
      requestedEnd - The requested rental end date.
      Returns:
      true if the vehicle is available for the requested period, otherwise false.

    • showCustomerRentals

      public void showCustomerRentals(String customerId)
      Displays all rental records for a specific customer.
      Parameters:
      customerId - The ID of the customer whose rentals will be displayed.

    • saveRentalToFile

      public void saveRentalToFile(String[] vehicle, String customerId, String customerName, String customerPhone, String customerEmail, String startDate, String endDate, long rentalDays, double totalCost)
      Saves a new rental record to the rentals file.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - An array containing the vehicle information.
      customerId - The customer's ID.
      customerName - The customer's name.
      customerPhone - The customer's phone number.
      customerEmail - The customer's email address.
      startDate - The rental start date.
      endDate - The rental end date.
      rentalDays - The total number of rental days.
      totalCost - The total rental cost.
